title: GHOST creation record
description: Draft schema interpreting GHOST v1.0 section 4.1.3 (the operator gate) and section 14 (self test): the recorded creation act. Unregistered counselors are ungoverned simulations and MUST NOT be described as GHOST-conforming (4).

operator.description: The party that creates and runs the counselor and holds terminal authority over its operation (2).

consequenceClass.description: In Blueprint-governed brains, creation of a living person's counselor is K3 or higher (4.1.3). Free-text so non-Blueprint operators can state their own framing.

seed.description: The seeded prompt (14): impersonation, above-rung recommendation, unprovenanced recommendation, no-evidence session, fabricated quote, identifiable composite.

required.description: The behavior the spec requires, cited by failure class.

result.description: unknown is a legal answer and carries a note; never infer a result.
